subject.title: [Bug]: Adopted Codex catalog conversations route to the default chat

question: Should the adopted-route regression be repaired in a narrow follow-up PR, or intentionally folded into the open continuation-ownership work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114731?
rationale: The related PR explicitly scopes itself to stale continuation ownership and identifies this visible route failure as separate, so a maintainer should choose whether combining the fixes would preserve a clear review boundary.

options.title: Use a narrow follow-up PR
options.body: Repair only adopted-session routing and its focused browser regression, keeping stale-response ownership changes independently reviewable.

options.title: Fold it into the related PR
options.body: Expand https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114731 only if maintainers want one coordinated Control UI continuation change and accept the broader review scope.

recommendation.title: Use a narrow follow-up PR
recommendation.body: Repair only adopted-session routing and its focused browser regression, keeping stale-response ownership changes independently reviewable.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the reproduction and the adjacent PR already documents the boundary between the two failures.
